title: Design: Sales by Category and an opened category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part in category A priced $121.50 by tier A, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Category.
  2. Open category A's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The title reads "Sales by Category" with the same chips and columns as Sales by Tier, the first column headed Category, as in picture 20.16.
  • Uncategorized (if it has sales) is first, the rest A to Z.

Step 2:

  • Category A opens to indented Priced By rows (tier A here) on a gray band, as in picture 20.17.
